summary: Together AI Startup Accelerator is a selection-based program, not a general signup grant. Approved startups receive up to $15K, $30K, or $50K in free platform credits depending on funding stage (under $5M / $5–10M / over $10M). Credits can be used for serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, fine-tuning, and instant clusters.
claim_steps: Confirm your startup is building an AI-native application.
Apply at together.ai/startup-accelerator (no card required to apply).
If selected, credits are granted according to funding tier: up to $15K / $30K / $50K.
